Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in repurposing existing electrified railways as mechanical energy storage via train operation modulation, avoiding new infrastructure. Analyzing 326,034 train operations, it estimates 190 GW global potential (2025), rising to 315–579 GW by 2050. Significance: 11.9–20.0% lower conventional storage investment (US$14.9–35.1 billion annually) and 94.3–258.9 Mt CO₂ reductions yearly without extra system cost.

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in enhancing supercapacitor capacitance by mixing ionic liquids to increase electric double layer disorder and entropy, rather than altering voltage windows. Significance: capacitance rose up to 150% across the entire stability window, with like-charged co-ions playing counterion-like roles. This reveals compositional entropy as a design lever for higher energy density, advancing next-generation storage.

item.title: Synergistic Solvation‐Interface Regulation via a Zincophilic‐Hydrophobic Additive Enables Deep‐Cycling Zinc Metal Anodes
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using C12-MADS as a dual-functional additive: sulfonate groups displace water from Zn2+ solvation and anchor to the zinc surface, while hydrophobic alkyl chains form a water-exclusive inner Helmholtz plane. This synergistically suppresses dendrites, hydrogen evolution, and corrosion, enabling 1600 h cycling at 10 mA cm−2 and stable full cells—offering a rational molecular design principle for durable aqueous zinc anodes.
🏷 aqueous zinc battery · electrolyte additive · solvation regulation · zinc anode · dendrite suppression

item.title: Pulsed‐Laser‐Engineered Cu Single Atoms in δ‐Bi 2 O 3 Nanosheets for Efficient Formate‐Producing Zn–CO 2 Batteries
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Pulsed laser irradiation in liquid simultaneously transforms α-Bi2O3 microrods into δ-Bi2O3 nanosheets and stabilizes Cu single atoms, achieving 93.55% formate Faradaic efficiency. Cu doping tunes adsorption energies and lowers the CO2-to-formate barrier. The Zn–CO2 battery delivers 1.74 V and stable operation over 300 h, demonstrating practical energy–carbon coupling.

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a self-supported CuOx@CNTs/CF electrode enabling hybrid Zn-air/Cu batteries to discharge under oxygen-free conditions by replacing ORR with CuO reduction, achieving 800 h cycling and 340 h oxygen-free operation.
